description: Copper Speakers is a Fabric/Polymer mod for Minecraft Java Edition 26.3, for single-player worlds and multiplayer servers. Place a jukebox, lay copper wire, connect speakers, and insert a music disc to play it around your build.

mods.name: Copper Speakers
mods.description: Connect jukeboxes and speakers with copper wire in single-player worlds and multiplayer servers.

releases.notes:
Copper Speakers 0.3.5 fixes Bedrock resuming from the beginning after joining a playing prepared track through a dimension change.

- Reopen nonzero starts muted, seek the running voices to their shared song clock, then unmute them as one ordered group. This handles the native client losing the offset supplied during reopening.
- Keep playback from the beginning on the coordinated startup path. Running seeks follow the existing clock even when callbacks are delayed. Ejection, replacement and disconnect cancel stale seeks and unmutes.
- Update the Bedrock and prepared-joining documentation, including the silent native preparation delay.
- Includes the pick-block and item-name fixes from 0.3.4, speaker-facing correction, and removal of loading/joining countdown action bars.

**Verification:** 49 Minecraft GameTests, 18 JUnit tests, six Python release/visual tests, supported Bedrock codec and coordination regressions, and complete bundle/source/license audits. Native Windows Bedrock recordings cover `/ptp` round trips through the Plan project's Nether while the jukebox circuit remains loaded, with the same session and epoch and no disc changes. The recording is silent during preparation and rejoins the ongoing recording instead of replaying its intro. These checks cover the supported client build; they are not an every-device timing guarantee.

**Downloads:** `copper-speakers-0.3.5.jar` for Java, or `copper-speakers-0.3.5-bedrock-fabric.zip` for the complete mod, extensions, packs and mappings. Source archives, compatibility metadata and checksums are included. Custom recordings remain in their separately published music pack. Prepared joining must be enabled for each track and becomes active on its next insertion.

**Target:** Minecraft Java 26.3, Java 25, Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, Geyser-Fabric 2.12.1 build 1273, Bedrock 26.60 / protocol 2225. Install Fabric API and Polymer separately. Rebuild against the server's generated Polymer pack when allocations differ.

[Bedrock setup](https://github.com/mcneds/Copper-Speakers/blob/v0.3.5/compat/bedrock/README.md) · [Prepared joining](https://github.com/mcneds/Copper-Speakers/blob/v0.3.5/docs/late-listeners.md)

releases.notes:
Copper Speakers 0.3.4 fixes Bedrock pick-block and untranslated item names.

- Forward pick requests for modded states outside Geyser's vanilla registry to Minecraft's normal server handler. Geyser-Fabric previously resolved these states as air and discarded the request. Vanilla blocks and item frames retain the original path, and Minecraft still checks range, permissions and requested block data.
- Supply the mod's bundled English translations to Geyser's component renderer. Copper Wire, Speaker and Wall Plate now show their names instead of translation keys; player-written names are preserved.
- Update the Bedrock compatibility README and matching downloads.

**Verification:** 49 Minecraft GameTests, 18 JUnit tests, six Python visual/release tests, supported Bedrock codec and lifecycle checks, the new pick/name regressions, and bundle/source/license audits passed locally and in tagged CI. A native Bedrock check picked the placed wire from an empty hotbar slot and displayed “Copper Wire”.

**Known issue under investigation:** native Bedrock seeking after a prepared dimension return can restart audio at the beginning despite receiving a nonzero playback offset. This release does not claim that issue is fixed.

**Downloads:** use `copper-speakers-0.3.4.jar` for Java, or `copper-speakers-0.3.4-bedrock-fabric.zip` for the complete mod, both Geyser extensions, both packs and mappings. Source archives, compatibility metadata and checksums are included. Custom music remains in its separately published music pack.

**Target:** Minecraft Java 26.3, Java 25, Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, Geyser-Fabric 2.12.1 build 1273, Bedrock 26.60 / protocol 2225. Install Fabric API and Polymer separately. Rebuild against the server's generated Polymer pack when its allocations differ.

[Bedrock setup](https://github.com/mcneds/Copper-Speakers/blob/v0.3.4/compat/bedrock/README.md)

releases.notes:
Copper Speakers 0.3.3 corrects Bedrock speaker facing and makes prepared joining silent.

- Speaker drivers now face the same direction as Java in all four horizontal orientations. The conversion uses the opposite Bedrock yaw instead of adding a half-turn, correcting north/south while preserving east/west. The regression checks the actual driver normal and fails against the previous converter. The correction was also checked using client-only updates of the placed speakers.
- Removed the loading and joining countdown from the action bar for all players. Background preparation, distance entry and scheduled late admission continue normally. The normal song title is restricted to listeners near an active source.
- Clarified that players arriving after insertion, including through dimension changes, require prepared joining for that sound. Enable it with the published mono recording and start a new disc session after preparation reports ready. Existing listeners keep their current playback while settings are prepared.

**Verification:** all 49 Minecraft GameTests, 18 JUnit tests, six Python release/visual tests, supported Bedrock codec and lifecycle checks, and complete bundle/source/license audits passed. An additional isolated two-client attempt was inconclusive because the local test server exhausted native JVM memory before the joining checks; it is not counted as a passing test.

**Downloads:** `copper-speakers-0.3.3.jar` for Java; `copper-speakers-0.3.3-bedrock-fabric.zip` for the complete mod, extensions, packs and mappings. Java and display source archives, compatibility metadata and checksums are included. Custom music stays in its separately published music pack.

**Target:** Minecraft Java 26.3, Java 25, Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, Geyser-Fabric 2.12.1 build 1273, Bedrock 26.60 / protocol 2225. Fabric API and Polymer remain separate dependencies. Rebuild against the server's actual Polymer pack when allocations differ.

[Bedrock setup](https://github.com/mcneds/Copper-Speakers/blob/v0.3.3/compat/bedrock/README.md) · [Prepared joining](https://github.com/mcneds/Copper-Speakers/blob/v0.3.3/docs/late-listeners.md)

releases.notes:
Copper Speakers 0.3.2 fixes large Bedrock speaker groups starting out of sync.

Fresh starts still load audio muted. At their common release, CopperBedrock stops and recreates the native voices at the requested opening position, submitting the group together on the transport event loop. This avoids relying on paused voices aligning after a seek. Subsequent stops remain ordered behind the recreated group. Late attachments preserve the existing song clock and leave already-playing speakers alone.

Automatic buffered custom-song selection from 0.3.1 remains available. The Bedrock README explains the startup behavior and the limits of timing verification.

**Verification:** all 49 Minecraft server GameTests, 19 JUnit tests, six Python release/visual tests, supported Bedrock codec/lifecycle checks and complete bundle/source/license audits passed. The lifecycle regression models paused voices ignoring seeks and checks that stopped voices cannot be recreated.

Actual Windows Bedrock 26.60 recordings tested 24 simultaneous voices with two custom songs, including a fresh-client start and a repeat. The all-source recordings were coherent and sampled voice pairs measured below the 1 ms reporting resolution. A late-attachment sample measured approximately 1.7 ms. These measurements describe that client and workload, not a guarantee for every device.

**Downloads:** `copper-speakers-0.3.2.jar` for Java; `copper-speakers-0.3.2-bedrock-fabric.zip` for the complete mod, extensions, packs and mappings. Display and Java source archives, compatibility metadata and SHA-256 checksums are attached. Private custom music is not included.

**Target:** Minecraft Java 26.3, Java 25, Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, Geyser-Fabric 2.12.1 build 1273, Bedrock 26.60 / protocol 2225. Fabric API and Polymer are separate dependencies. Rebuild against the actual Polymer pack when server allocations differ.

[Bedrock setup](https://github.com/mcneds/Copper-Speakers/blob/v0.3.2/compat/bedrock/README.md) · [Installation](https://github.com/mcneds/Copper-Speakers/blob/v0.3.2/compat/bedrock/INSTALL.md)

releases.notes:
Copper Speakers 0.3.1 automatically uses installed buffered custom-song aliases for Bedrock playback, including prepared starts and late joins.

- CopperBedrock scans Geyser's loaded local, unencrypted Bedrock packs at startup. When `<namespace>:buffered.<song>` is non-streaming and matches the original recording and playback settings, it selects that alias automatically. This works with wiki-generated music and other namespaces without per-song configuration.
- Prepared playback keeps its original seek offset. Existing buffered events remain unchanged. Missing, streamed or mismatched aliases fall back to the original event; explicit `sounds.json` entries take precedence.
- Reload/restart Geyser after publishing updated music packs. Adding songs does not require rebuilding the extension. Remote/encrypted packs and differently named aliases can still use explicit mappings.
- Fixes an intermittent cancellation-test failure caused by walking a directory while the audio worker renamed a temporary file. The test now waits for the consumed completion.

**Downloads:** use `copper-speakers-0.3.1.jar` for Java, or `copper-speakers-0.3.1-bedrock-fabric.zip` for the complete Fabric/Geyser setup, including the mod, both extensions, both packs, block/item mappings, installation guide, licenses and display source. Java and display sources, compatibility metadata and SHA-256 checksums are also attached.

**Target:** Minecraft Java 26.3, Java 25, Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, Geyser-Fabric 2.12.1 build 1273, Bedrock 26.60 / protocol 2225. Install Fabric API and the Polymer bundle separately. Servers with different Polymer allocations should rebuild the bundle against their actual generated pack.

**Verification:** 49 Minecraft server GameTests, 19 JUnit tests, Python release/visual tests, supported Bedrock codec and audio coordination checks, bundle/source/license audits, and new regressions for wiki aliases, prepared rejoin offsets, new songs, overrides and safe fallback. These checks do not measure physical Bedrock client audio timing.

[Bedrock setup](https://github.com/mcneds/Copper-Speakers/blob/v0.3.1/compat/bedrock/README.md) · [Installation](https://github.com/mcneds/Copper-Speakers/blob/v0.3.1/compat/bedrock/INSTALL.md)
